description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values across four categories of political leaning—“Left bias,” “Left center bias,” “Quest. source,” and “Right bias”—with each bar segmented into three colored portions representing the proportions of “HERO” (blue), “VICTIM” (brown), and “VILLAIN” (light blue) narrative roles. The horizontal axis lists the four political leaning categories, ordered from left to right as “Left bias,” “Left center bias,” “Quest. source,” and “Right bias.” The vertical axis represents the FOCUS value, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each bar is a vertical stack of colored segments, with the blue “HERO” segment at the bottom, the brown “VICTIM” segment in the middle, and the light blue “VILLAIN” segment at the top. The “Left bias” bar has approximate values of 0.3 for HERO, 0.1 for VICTIM, and 0.6 for VILLAIN, totaling 1.0. The “Left center bias” bar shows approximately 0.3 for HERO, 0.2 for VICTIM, and 0.5 for VILLAIN. The “Quest. source” bar has approximately 0.4 for HERO, 0.05 for VICTIM, and 0.55 for VILLAIN. The “Right bias” bar shows approximately 0.3 for HERO, 0.1 for VICTIM, and 0.6 for VILLAIN. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond the standard color coding and legend.
